plainText:
Gregory "Greg" Abbey is an American actor and voice actor, previously voicing characters in the English-language dub of . He is sometimes credited as Frank Frankson or John Campbell. He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists and TalentWorks.

==Biography==
Abbey was born on December 15, 1970, in Great Falls, Montana, but he spent his childhood moving around the United States due to his parent being in the . He graduated from Rutgers University as an adult and pursued a voice acting career afterwards. Abbey began to provide voices for around the sixth season. He provided the voice of Scott in The Scheme Team, Numero Uno Articuno and The Symbol Life, as well as several additional roles until and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. He later returned to the series in Hot Springing a Leak!.
